note.zh: 在 Qwen Studio 网页端以 Qwen3.8-Max-Preview（Thinking）使用仓库标准中文提示词一次生成，未使用外部技能、插件、MCP 或自定义系统提示。提交前清理了 artifact 中的 emoji 及装饰性 Unicode 字符（如入口按钮的剑号、昼夜状态图标、分隔符等），以符合仓库 no-emoji 规则，其余内容为原始产出。
note.en: Generated in one shot by Qwen3.8-Max-Preview (Thinking) in Qwen Studio Web using the repository's canonical Chinese prompt, without external skills, plugins, MCP servers, or a custom system prompt. Before submission, emoji and decorative Unicode characters (e.g. sword symbol on the enter button, day/night status icons, separators) were removed from the artifact to comply with the repo's no-emoji rule; all other content is the original output.
